reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator models ingestion health as a temporal condition on the latest successful run. The system's design assumes that any ingestion activity—whether via paid odds or free settlement—must produce a durable SUCCESS marker to qualify as healthy. This creates a dualism where free path operations, while valid, must still conform to the same durability requirement. Failure occurs when either the paid path skips writes due to key deactivation or the free path fails to emit a SUCCESS run. The freshness SLA acts as a temporal gatekeeper, ensuring that stale runs do not falsely indicate system health. The derived kernel maps this into a Bayesian framework where the posterior probability of health depends on the elapsed time since lastSuccessAt, conditioned on whether the system is operating under paid or free mode.
